policy.sourceLayer: source.json is immutable and preserves all repeated lesson rows.
policy.existingProjectLayer: Existing w17-* records remain authoritative for their own reviewed corrections and lifecycle metadata; this package does not overwrite them.
policy.modularRuntimeLayer: Only src/** and src/runtime-resources/** may be named as runtime owners. main.js is generated and excluded.
policy.evidenceBoundary: Pedagogical attestation, tests, parser output, and prior project promotion do not independently establish grammatical productivity, identity, frequency, or dialect-wide naturalness.

knownSourceAlerts.note: Casual, polite, and standard labels remain source metadata.
攰, 嬲, and 驚 each occur twice in the source; the project later deduplicated them.
The lesson groups multifunctional verbs, coverbs, conjunctions, and complex forms under Prepositions.
The source gives 闊 kut3; existing project records correct it to fut3.
The /yː/ versus /uː/ heading does not transparently describe every listed pair.
The phonics comparison with Mandarin is preserved but not adopted as project evidence.
